name: showcase-design-tournament
description: Competition as a quality mechanism. Two designers on different model families draw against the SAME brief without seeing each other's work; an independent judge on a third family scores both against stated criteria; the conductor runs a revision round and stops at a human gate before anything is promoted. The judge never learns which family produced which entry.

brief.description: What to design, and for whom

criteria.default: fitness for the stated audience, originality, and internal consistency — in that order

rounds.description: Revision rounds after the first scoring

agents.instructions: Send the identical brief to both designers in one send. Never show one designer the other's work or score. When both have replied, forward BOTH entries to the judge as A and B without saying which model produced which — the judge must not be able to favour a family. Relay only the judge's criticism back to each designer, then run the revision round. Stop before promoting anything and report both entries, both scores, and what changed between rounds.

You score two anonymous entries, A and B, against the stated criteria. You do not know which model produced which, and you must not guess. Score each criterion separately with a one-sentence justification, then state which entry wins and what would have to change for the loser to win.
